what_is_closed: Exact rational reconstruction of the KRSW linearized harmonic plane-boundary hierarchy at normal incidence for each face orientation.
For each one-face map q=M p, an explicitly constructed positive quadratic form H satisfies the declared characteristic-form identity exactly.
The two-face algebraic composition has an exact fixed amplitude; this is a boundary-map composition result, not a slab evolution mode.
what_remains_open: Tangential-frequency, glancing, imaginary/general complex-frequency and high-frequency domains are not covered.
The constructed H and chi-weighted quadratic form are an algebraic certificate, not yet identified with the energy norm of the evolving Core GH discretization.
No two-face slab evolution, corner treatment, variable-coefficient or nonlinear GH CPBC estimate is established.
The exact neutral boundary-map amplitude means the one-face estimate does not prove strict two-face dissipation.

equation_or_mapping.linear_characteristics: q=Pi-Phi_n=-a; p=Pi+Phi_n=-b; a=(partial_t+s partial_x)gamma; b=(partial_t-s partial_x)gamma
equation_or_mapping.boundary_map: A_s a + B_s b=0; q=M_s p; M_s=-A_s^{-1}B_s after exact trace reversal gamma_ab=-h_ab+(1/2)eta_ab eta^cd h_cd
equation_or_mapping.quadratic_form: H=W+r^-1 M^T W M+r^-2 (M^2)^T W M^2; W=diag(1 for diagonal, 2 for off-diagonal symmetric tensor slots); chi=1/4; r=(1-chi)/(1+chi)=3/5
equation_or_mapping.declared_characteristic_flux_form: F=(chi-1)p^T H p/2+(chi+1)q^T H q/2=-(1-chi)p^T W p/2=-3 p^T W p/8 for q=M p
equation_or_mapping.two_face_composition: M_left M_right v=v, v_(t,y)=v_(x,y)=1 and all other symmetric components zero

major_result.units: Dimensionless amplitudes in a flat-background linearized standard-GR normal-incidence lane; no SI observable map.
major_result.derivation_class: exact rational linear algebra over the published KRSW plane-boundary hierarchy
major_result.observable: declared quadratic characteristic boundary form, not a physical detector observable
major_result.data_role: published standard-GR equation comparator plus exact internal algebra; no empirical data, fit, or holdout
open_blockers: identify a compatible energy norm and prove a two-face discrete slab estimate for the full GH evolution
extend the frequency analysis beyond normal incidence and connect the imported boundary theorem hypotheses to the Core GH system
major_result.claim_boundary: A CLOSED_FOR_LANE exact algebraic comparator only; not a Core curved 3+1 closure, full GH well-posedness proof, UET validation, Gravity compatibility, or evidence for Topic 13.
